subject: IntegraFi authz implementation handshake — SAML/SCIM, IP allowlists, service accounts
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@integrafi.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Ken O'Neil <ken.oneil@integrafi.com>, IntegraFi IT <it@integrafi.com>
Date: 2027-10-09T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff — AuthZ & access for Redwood rollout

Thanks for the kickoff today, Vanessa. A few follow-ups from our side so we can get SAML and SCIM synced with minimal friction: 

- SSO: we use Okta and will create an app once we have the ACS and EntityID values. Can you send the SAML metadata endpoint (or XML) and the expected certificate format?
- SCIM: we'd like a one-way push from Redwood to our directory (create / update / deactivate). Does Redwood support groups-to-attributes mapping? Any attribute naming constraints we should know about?
- IP allowlists: attached is our current egress allowlist. We need a short maintenance window to coordinate any IP changes — what's the recommended maintenance policy?

Also looping in Ken (procurement) since they want the final scope for the implementation hours estimate.

Appreciate a clear checklist and who owns each item on your side.

Thanks,
Marta
Director, Identity & Security
IntegraFi

Attachments: integrafi-ip-list.csv (CSV, 3 rows)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@integrafi.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Ken O'Neil <ken.oneil@integrafi.com>
Date: 2027-10-09T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff — AuthZ & access for Redwood rollout

Marta — great to meet you on the call. Summary + next steps below (I attached a brief "Prereqs" doc):

1) SAML/SSO
   - Deliverable (Redwood): SAML metadata URL + X.509 cert (PEM) and ACS/EntityID values by EOD 10/10.
   - Action (IntegraFi): Create Okta app once you receive values and notify us when test users are added.
   - Notes: We support IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows and recommend SP-initiated for the first test.

2) SCIM
   - Deliverable (Redwood): SCIM base endpoint + sample provisioning payloads; default mapping supports name, email, title, active flag.
   - Action (IntegraFi): Confirm attribute names to map groups (if you want group->role mapping, provide the group attribute name).
   - Notes: SCIM uses OAuth bearer tokens from your admin; we support bulk sync and near-real-time events in 30s batching.

3) IP allowlists & maintenance
   - Deliverable (IntegraFi): Confirm production allowlist CSV.
   - Action (Redwood): We'll produce a scheduled change window for any IP updates. For SLA-tier customers we allow one planned IP change without incident impact if scheduled 72h in advance.

4) Service accounts & org policies
   - Deliverable (Redwood): Naming conventions and least-privilege role templates (attached sample).
   - Action (IntegraFi): Define 1–2 service accounts for provisioning and monitoring; provide owners.

Timeline proposal:
- 10/10: Redwood send SAML metadata + SCIM endpoints + service account naming doc (attached).
- 10/11–10/12: IntegraFi creates Okta app and adds 2 test users.
- 10/13: Test SAML sign-on; validate SCIM create/update on staging.
- 10/14: Cutover plan review and IP allowlist finalization.

I'll loop Marissa (CS lead) and Neha (security engineer) for technical pairing. Jonas will own the rollout checklist and go/no-go. If this works, we'll book a 30-45m pairing session tomorrow 10/10 at 10:00 PT — is that OK?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Customer Success, Redwood Inference

Attachments: integrafi_sso_scim_prereqs.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@integrafi.com>

Date: 2027-10-10T10:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff — AuthZ & access for Redwood rollout

Following up with technical details I promised on the call:

SAML metadata and cert: 
- SP EntityID: https://redwood-inference.com/saml/sp/integrafi
- ACS URL: https://redwood-inference.com/saml/sp/integrafi/acs
- Metadata URL (XML): https://redwood-inference.com/saml/metadata/integrafi.xml
- X.509 certificate (PEM) attached in the prereqs doc.

SCIM provisioning: 
- SCIM base: https://api.redwood-inference.com/v2/scim/integrafi
- Bearer token will be generated by your admin and stored on your side; send token via our secure form (link below) or use the temporary test token we provided on the call.
- Supported attributes: userName (email), name.givenName, name.familyName, title, active (boolean), groups.
- Group mapping: we accept a 'groups' array; to map groups->roles in Redwood, send attribute 'groups' with exact group names. If you need group->role transformations, we'll add a mapping rule in the provisioning config.

Service account guidance: 
- Recommended: two accounts: redwood-provisioner@integrafi and redwood-monitor@integrafi.
- Permissions: provisioner = users:create, users:update, groups:read; monitor = users:read, audit:read.

IP allowlist notes: 
- We require CIDR ranges. For short-term test traffic we can whitelist 3 ephemeral addresses; production requires CIDR blocks and a maintenance window for changes (72h notice for non-emergency).

Secure token submission form: https://drive.redwood.com/integrafi/secure-token-submission

I'll validate the sample SCIM payload during the test tomorrow. Let me know if you want us to push a staging user instead of relying on Okta's test users.

-Neha
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Kickoff — AuthZ & access for Redwood rollout (estimate & next steps)

Ken — thanks for the ask. Short answers below and attached a one-page estimate.

Estimated PS hours (SAML + SCIM pairing + staging validation + one remediation cycle): 8 hours (2 engineers: Neha & Jonas) + 1 CS day for coordination (Marissa) = billed as 12h.
Additional line items: 
- IP allowlist maintenance: included for the initial cutover. Ongoing emergency IP changes outside scheduled windows billed at time-and-materials.
- Custom service account roles: we include two templated roles as noted; custom role creation (beyond minor name changes) is 2h of engineering time if needed.

Action items and owners:
- Redwood (Vanessa/Neha/Jonas): send signed estimate + SAML metadata + SCIM endpoints (done 10/10).
- IntegraFi (Marta/Ken): provision Okta test app and add test users; reply with final production IP CIDRs by EOD 10/13.
- Procurement (Ken): route PO against deal D-INTG-2027-09; target approval 10/15.

If PO timeline slips, we can still complete staging tests; production cutover will wait until PO is complete if you require purchase order gating.

I'll attach the estimate and the service-account naming doc for your records. Ready to run the staging test on 10/13 as planned.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
